items.prompt: Milo bends several objects gently. Which one bends without breaking?
items.explanation: A rubber band stretches and bends, then can return to its shape. A stone, glass jar, and metal spoon resist bending.

items.prompt: Maxine spills a little water and compares materials. Which one absorbs it?
items.explanation: A paper towel has spaces that soak up water. A glass jar, stone, and aluminum foil do not absorb it in the same way.

items.prompt: Milo taps a wooden ruler and a metal spoon. Which material is hard?
items.explanation: A metal spoon is firm and resists bending, which is evidence that it is hard. The other choices are softer or more bendable.

items.prompt: Maxine uses a wooden ruler to draw a straight line. Which property helps?
items.explanation: The ruler stays firm instead of bending while Maxine draws, so hardness helps it measure a straight line.

items.prompt: Before studying the ruler, which action is safe?

options.text: Look at it and touch it gently

items.explanation: Looking and gentle touching let Maxine observe without causing harm. Tasting, throwing, and weathering an object are unsafe choices.
